about: The Workbench icons of the Heroes drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is a square from the game's title picture (heroes-data pics/heroes.pcx). Heroes-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Heroes.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licences and the manual; Folder.info for data.
